name: Liedberg prophylactic conduit mesh
question: Does prophylactic sublay mesh reduce clinical parastomal hernia after open cystectomy with ileal conduit?

arms.label: Prophylactic sublay Vypro mesh at ileal conduit construction
conventional ileal conduit construction without mesh

design.population: Adults scheduled for open radical cystectomy for bladder cancer with ileal conduit and no previous stoma at two Swedish university hospitals and one county hospital.
design.description: Three-center, open-label, closed-envelope randomized superiority trial

verdictNote: Time-to-event analysis met significance; the 24-month binary comparison did not.
takeaway: In open cystectomy with ileal conduit, prophylactic sublay Vypro mesh reduced the hazard of clinical parastomal hernia versus conventional stoma construction without mesh (HR 0.45, 95% CI 0.24–0.86); median operating time was longer.

reports.label: Randomized trial
reports.citation: Liedberg F, Kollberg P, Allerbo M, et al. "Preventing Parastomal Hernia After Ileal Conduit by the Use of a Prophylactic Mesh: A Randomised Study." *Eur Urol.* 2020;78(5):757-763. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2020.07.033
reports.followUp: Median 3 years in each arm among patients without parastomal hernia (IQR 2–5 years mesh; 2–4 years control)

results.measure: Time to clinical parastomal hernia over follow-up; total events among 241 evaluable patients
results.note: The analysis was changed from the initially planned binary 24-month comparison to time-to-event analysis during the trial; Table 3 reports total clinical hernia events.
results.locator: Full text, Statistics, p 758; Table 3 and Figure 2, p 761

results.measure: Binary comparison of 24-month clinical hernia counts among patients alive at 24 months
results.note: The article reports 11% versus 23%; 20/89 = 22.47%, which rounds to 22% to the nearest whole percent.
results.locator: Full text, Table 2 and footnote, p 760; Abstract, p 757

results.note: Adjusted for operating hospital, body mass index and preoperative chemotherapy.
results.locator: Full text, Results, p 759 (citing Supplementary Table 1)

results.measure: Patients operated for parastomal hernia during follow-up

harms.label: Highest Clavien-Dindo grade 3–5 complication within 90 days
harms.note: One randomized control patient did not receive an ileal conduit and was excluded from the evaluable cohort.

harms.label: Highest Clavien-Dindo grade 1–2 complication within 90 days
Conduit ischemia and mesh complications

values.exp: One partial conduit ischemia; no other potential mesh-related complication within 90 days
values.ctl: One complete conduit ischemia requiring reoperation within 90 days

harms.locator: Full text, Results, p 759; Discussion, pp 761–762
harms.note: No prophylactic-mesh complication was noted during long-term follow-up. At later hernia repair, one control patient received a sublay mesh that eroded into the conduit and required revision.

harms.label: Postoperative infection among grade 3–5 complication categories
harms.locator: Full text, Table 4, p 761; Table 1, p 760
harms.note: Infection counts are from Table 4 and whole-arm denominators from Table 1. Table 4 gives n=31 per arm for grade 3–5 categories, differing from Table 1's highest-grade totals of 32/118 mesh and 30/123 control; the paper does not reconcile these denominators.

harms.label: Other stoma reoperations and prolapse during follow-up

values.exp: 1/118 reoperation for flat stoma bud; 1/118 minor prolapse treated conservatively

harms.note: The mesh-arm reoperation was local, without laparotomy.

delivery.label: Stoma site and mesh placement
delivery.value: Stoma marked in the right rectus by a stoma nurse or operating urologist; 10 × 10 cm Vypro lightweight mesh (Ethicon) placed in a sublay position.
delivery.locator: Full text, Surgical details, p 758; Abstract, p 757
delivery.note: The full operative insertion method was placed in supplementary material, which was not available in the retrieved article.

delivery.label: Median operating time
delivery.locator: Full text, Results, p 759; Table 1, p 760

delivery.label: Conduit construction
delivery.value: Anterior fixation of the conduit to the rectus sheath was used in both study arms.
